scope: Synthetic teaching models, not captured workload data or hardware timing predictions

scheduler.scope: One illustrative scheduler on one SM; one issue opportunity per step
scheduler.selection: Round robin among eligible resident warps
limitations: More warps add work; total steps across these cases are not a fixed-work speedup comparison
Active, eligible and selected are nested descriptions, not a partition
No registers, shared-memory capacity, execution pipelines, issue-width limits or memory bandwidth are simulated
The shared data arrival is a teaching scenario, not evidence of memory saturation

profiler.scope: Independent synthetic example, not measurements derived from the simulated scheduler
profiler.semantics: Measured kernel duration is distributed by PC sample Count. Integer nanosecond rounding residue is added to the last allocation, preserving the duration total.
limitations: Per-PC and per-state allocations are not independently measured instruction or stall durations
A sampled warp waiting does not imply that the whole SM or scheduler issued nothing
These observations alone do not prove memory bandwidth saturation
PC evidence depends on device support, capture configuration and attribution support
